digest.component_or_area: Git ref reclamation helper and backup infrastructure
propositions: prepare_reclaim_backup.py must enumerate live origin heads and tags at runtime, collapse annotated-tag peeled OIDs onto canonical refs, and record exact direct and peeled OIDs without hardcoded counts
The helper must refuse partial/promisor clones, reject any pre-existing refs/reclaim-backup/ refs, create a run-unique namespace for temporary refs, and perform no remote writes or deletions
The generated bundle must exactly match the old-tip and requested pin-tip OID map, pass git bundle verify, and successfully restore to a throwaway repo with identical OIDs
Output bundle and manifest artifacts must never overwrite existing files, must be created outside the repository/Git directory/registered worktrees, and must be cleaned up on failure
The helper must verify remote origin heads and tags are byte-identical before and after execution, and leave no incomplete artifacts or helper refs on caught failure
A6-1 must create a fresh final bundle after quiescence if the observed quiet-window old tip differs from the rehearsal old tip recorded in this ticket
